comment: Chain selection config. Kept out of the scripts so the rules are visible and reviewable.

chainIdOverrides.comment: DefiLlama reports chainId: null for some EVM chains. Every id here is verified against a live eth_chainId before the chain is included, and the chain is dropped with a warning if it does not match. Do not trust ethereum-lists/chains for identity: it lists 999 as Wanchain Testnet and 1514 as Data Network.

exclude.comment: Not EVM execution environments. Listed only to keep the unresolved-chain warning actionable.
exclude.note: Bittensor, Vaulta and XRPL do have EVM environments, but DefiLlama's TVL for those names is the native chain, not the EVM sidechain, so including them would attribute the wrong TVL to the wrong execution environment.
